other.raw: COMMENT ON TABLE public.degisim_log IS 'G-20260913-SURUM-GECMISI F1: immutable row-version log. One row per changed business row; txid groups a transaction.';
DO> $ DECLARE v_tablolar text[] := ARRAY[ 'cases','diseases','dogum','drug_administrations', 'drug_classes','drug_products','drugs','gorev_log','grup_padok_eslem',
DO> t text;
DO> v_args text;
DO> BEGIN FOR t IN SELECT cl.relname::text FROM pg_trigger g JOIN pg_class cl ON cl.oid = g.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace cn ON cn.oid = cl.relnamespace WHERE g.tgname
DO> END LOOP;
DO> FOREACH t IN ARRAY v_tablolar LOOP SELECT string_agg(quote_literal(a.attname), ', ' ORDER BY k.ord) INTO v_args FROM pg_constraint c CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(c
DO> IF v_args IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'degisim_log attach: % has no primary key', t;
DO> END IF;
DO> IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint c2 CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(c2.conkey) AS u(attnum) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c2.conrelid AND a.attnum = u.at
DO> END IF;
DO> EXECUTE format('DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_degisim_log ON public.%I', t);
DO> EXECUTE format( 'CREATE TRIGGER trg_degisim_log AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.%I ' 'FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public._degisim_log_yaz(%s)', t,
DO> END LOOP;
DO> END;
DO> $
